entry.title: Likely: Galaxy S27 family has four models, including a compact S27 Pro
entry.summary: Samsung will release the Galaxy S27, S27+, S27 Pro and S27 Ultra.

entry.title: Rumor: Realme 17 Pro series gets a 10,000mAh battery, 200MP camera and 3.5x telephoto
entry.summary: An upcoming Realme 17 Pro or 17 Pro+ has a flat 1.5K 120Hz OLED (165Hz in some games), the Dimensity 7500, a 200MP main camera, a 50MP 3.5x telephoto, a 10,000mAh battery and a plastic frame.

entry.title: Confirmed: vivo X500 series costs INR 119,999-229,999 in India, launching late November
entry.summary: The vivo X500 (12/256GB) will cost INR 119,999, the X500 Pro INR 149,999 and the X500 Pro Max INR 159,999 (INR 179,999 for 512GB; INR 229,999 for a 'master set'), with a launch toward the end of November.

entry.title: Likely: MacBook Neo 2 with A19 Pro and 12GB of RAM arrives around March 2027
entry.summary: Apple's second MacBook Neo moves from the A18 Pro with 8GB of RAM to the A19 Pro with 12GB and launches in the iOS/macOS 27.4 window (February-March 2027), possibly in new colors; Apple plans to refresh the Neo's colors often.

entry.title: Rumor: Redmi K100 Ultra gets three 50MP rear cameras, including a 3x telephoto
entry.summary: A K100 Ultra engineering sample has three 50MP rear cameras (a roughly 1/1.3-inch main sensor, an upgraded ultrawide and a telephoto of about 3x whose sensor size is still being tested) and a 32MP selfie camera.

entry.title: Rumor: HMD Rise 4G is coming to India as a rebranded HMD Arc 2
entry.summary: HMD is preparing the HMD Rise 4G for India through Flipkart, a rebrand of the HMD Arc 2 with a 5,000mAh battery, 6.52-inch 720p LCD, Unisoc SC9863A, 4GB of RAM, 13MP rear camera, 10W charging and Android 14 Go.

entry.title: Rumor: Redmi Note 18 5G passes 3C certification with 45W charging
entry.summary: Model M077CE in China's 3C database is the vanilla Redmi Note 18 5G and supports 45W wired charging; earlier leaks say it is essentially a Note 17 5G with a larger battery (8,888mAh in China, 8,100mAh globally).

entry.title: Rumor: A redesigned MacBook Air, possibly with OLED, arrives in late 2027 or 2028
entry.summary: After an M6 refresh without a redesign in early 2027, Apple will overhaul the MacBook Air's design in late 2027 or 2028, and OLED is likely to be part of it.

entry.title: Rumor: iOS 28 brings a major revamp of iPhone notifications
entry.summary: Apple plans significant changes to the iPhone's Notification Center and notification system in iOS 28.

entry.title: Rumor: Apple's 19-20-inch foldable iPad (J312) slips to around 2029, at $3,000-$5,000
entry.summary: Apple is still developing Project J312, a foldable iPad with a roughly 19-20-inch screen and no outer display, which could cost $3,000-$5,000. Its target has slipped from 2027 to 2028 to around 2029, and its operating system (macOS, iPadOS or something new) is undecided.

entry.title: Rumor: Pixel phones get AI 'Priority notifications' pinned to the top of the shade
entry.summary: Google is adding Priority notifications to Pixel's Notification organizer: on-device AI picks time-sensitive notifications, pins them to the top of the shade and may color-highlight them. Notification Intelligence may be renamed Notification organizer, and the current organizer renamed Notification bundles.

entry.title: Rumor: Tesla's FSD (sold in Europe as Assisted Driving) wins EU-wide approval by Q1 2027
entry.summary: The EU's Technical Committee on Motor Vehicles will approve Tesla's supervised driver-assistance system for the whole bloc, which Elon Musk said he would be surprised to see take longer than Q1 2027.

entry.title: Rumor: Nvidia cuts gaming GPU supply to Chinese card makers by 20-30% this quarter
entry.summary: Graphics card makers in China will get 20-30% fewer Nvidia gaming GPUs from November to January, after an already tight Q3, making consumer GPU prices volatile.

entry.title: Rumor: SpaceX and Tesla could announce a merger as soon as December
entry.summary: SpaceX and Tesla are progressing toward a merger that could be announced as soon as December 2026, though it may slip into early 2027.

entry.title: Likely: Apple revives (PRODUCT)RED with a red HomePod mini 2 and AirPods Max 2
entry.summary: Apple will release a HomePod mini 2 with red mesh and a silver AirPods Max 2 with white cushions and headband and a red Digital Crown, plus red AirPods Wrist Strap and Apple Watch Sport Band, tied to World AIDS Day on Dec 1.

entry.title: Rumor: Motorola Razr 2027 brings a 4-inch cover screen and launches in January
entry.summary: The base Razr 2027 (codename Raptor; likely Razr 80 outside North America) gets a 4-inch 120Hz cover screen, a 6.9-inch 144Hz main screen, a Dimensity 7550X, 8GB/256GB, a 5,000mAh battery with 45W wired and 15W wireless charging, IPX8/IPX9, Android 17 with three OS updates, 14.6mm folded and 195g, and launches in January, months earlier than usual.

entry.title: Rumor: Galaxy Z TriFold 2 (Q9m) is a limited release around mid-2027
entry.summary: Samsung's second tri-fold is codenamed Q9m, will again launch only in a few countries like the first TriFold, and will be thinner, lighter and more durable with a new hinge, possibly around mid-2027.

entry.title: Rumor: OnePlus Nord 7 has a camera light bar and a Dimensity 8500
entry.summary: The OnePlus Nord 7 has a light strip in its camera module, two rear cameras, a Dimensity 8500, a 144Hz AMOLED screen, and a 9,000mAh battery with 80W charging.

entry.title: Rumor: Lenovo Legion Go Beam is an Android handheld built for game streaming
entry.summary: Lenovo's leaked Legion Go Beam runs Android rather than Windows 11 or SteamOS, streams games from PCs and consoles, and has a 7-inch 120Hz screen, Wi-Fi 6E, a microSD slot and a headphone jack.

entry.title: Rumor: Most big phone makers cut their 2027 shipment targets; only Honor holds
entry.summary: Because of memory costs, vivo plans 60 million phones in 2027 (from 85 million), Xiaomi 90 million (from 120 million), OPPO 90 million (down 14%), Motorola 40 million (from 50 million), Samsung 210 million (from 232 million) and Apple 220 million (from 233 million); Honor keeps 50 million.

entry.title: Shaky: Galaxy S27 and S27+ start with just 8GB of RAM
entry.summary: Because of soaring memory prices, Samsung will sell 8GB/256GB versions of the Galaxy S27 and S27+ alongside 12GB/512GB models, while the S27 Pro and Ultra start at 12GB.

entry.title: Confirmed: Huawei Mate X8 foldable launches in November
entry.summary: Huawei will launch the Mate X8 in China in November with Kirin 9050/9050 Pro chips, an 8.15-inch inner and 6.5-inch cover screen, a 50MP 1/1.28-inch variable-aperture main camera, a 50MP periscope and a battery above 6,000mAh, plus a privacy-display version.

entry.title: Confirmed: Samsung readies a Galaxy Fit 4 that looks just like the Fit 3
entry.summary: Samsung will launch a Galaxy Fit 4 (SM-R391) fitness band with a near-identical design to the Fit 3, in black, white and light blue, at a similar low price.

entry.title: Confirmed: Motorola Edge 70 Neo has a Snapdragon 7s Gen 3, 7,000mAh battery and 144Hz screen
entry.summary: The Edge 70 Neo will have a 6.78-inch 144Hz AMOLED, Snapdragon 7s Gen 3, 50MP Sony LYTIA 710 main camera, 32MP selfie camera, 7,000mAh battery with 45W charging and IP64.

entry.title: Rumor: iPhone Air 2 gets a 6.55-inch 120Hz screen, A20 chip and two 48MP rear cameras
entry.summary: The iPhone Air 2 launches next spring with a 6.55-inch flat 120Hz OLED, a 2nm A20-series chip, 48MP wide and 48MP ultrawide rear cameras and a bigger battery than the first Air.

entry.title: Rumor: Galaxy Z Fold9 and Z Fold9 Ultra keep their predecessors' rear cameras
entry.summary: Samsung's 2027 book-style foldables carry over their rear cameras: the Fold9 Ultra keeps a 200MP main, 50MP ultrawide and 3x telephoto, and the wide Fold9 keeps 50MP main and 50MP ultrawide cameras.

entry.title: Confirmed: Huawei Watch Air is a 6.9mm titanium smartwatch with up to 5 days of battery
entry.summary: Huawei's upcoming Watch Air has a 6.9mm titanium unibody, an irregular high-silicon stacked battery (over 10% silicon) for up to five days of use, Watch GT 7 Pro-level activity tracking and Watch 6 sensors including ECG.

entry.title: Likely: Honor Magic V7 is a wide foldable, with no regular-shaped Magic V model next year
entry.summary: Honor's next book-style foldable, the Magic V7, uses a wide form factor, and Honor won't release a conventional tall foldable alongside it.

entry.title: Rumor: Galaxy S27 Ultra drops the laser autofocus sensor
entry.summary: Samsung removes the laser autofocus module that every Galaxy S Ultra has had since 2021 and relies on AI-based focusing instead, alongside dropping the 3x telephoto.

entry.title: Rumor: Only three Galaxy S27 configurations get LPDDR6 RAM and UFS 5.0 storage
entry.summary: LPDDR6 and UFS 5.0 go only into the 16GB/1TB S27 Pro and the 12GB/512GB and 16GB/1TB S27 Ultra; every other S27, S27+, S27 Pro and base S27 Ultra (12GB/256GB) uses LPDDR5X and UFS 4.1.
